_authority: AR-1254 §10 (bounded native-protection activation packet) + AR-1236 §11 (activate the existing toolbox, do not rebuild it)
_what_this_is: The manifest the pinned toolbox's claude-hook-runner.mjs requires. It does NOT restate the lane rules — those live in lane-boundary-guard.mjs::classifyPath inside the pinned toolbox, and a second copy of a boundary rule is a rule that drifts and stops biting while still reporting PASS. edit_scope NARROWS this packet on top of that.

session_anchor._expected_head_is_a_ref_on_purpose: resume-anchor-guard resolves expected_head with `rev-parse <x>^{commit}`, so a REF NAME works and a pinned SHA would go stale on the next commit — a guard that is stale by design gets disabled by whoever it annoys. Anchoring to the branch still catches a detached HEAD, the wrong branch, and a checkout that is not at the branch tip.
session_anchor._require_clean_is_true_and_currently_ref: TRUE on purpose. This worktree carries one unrelated dirty file, docs/wave25-exit-engine-ab-report.md — a timestamp-only regeneration from an earlier run. AR-1245 §9 says do not sweep it into G2 commits and do not use it as a reason to clean mid-G2, so it stands. The guard therefore refuses, and that refusal is CORRECT: the tree really is dirty. Setting this to false to obtain a green would be weakening a guard to hide a true finding. Its disposition belongs to the desk.

edit_scope._not_listed_is_not_allowed: Runtime, PAPER, broker/Topstep, compiler execution semantics and the backtester are absent deliberately. AR-1249 §12 and AR-1254 §12 keep them LOCKED, and Worker-2 production authority is not unlocked here.

finish._why_disabled: claude-finish-check needs a committed receipt file describing a finished packet. G2-D has not run, so there is no finished packet to check and enabling it would make TaskCompleted assert against a receipt that does not exist. It is switched on when a real finish receipt exists — an enabled check with nothing to check is the false-green shape this desk keeps convicting.
